description: Move your own pictures from your Switch library to the trash, where they can be brought back. Call it first without confirm: it lists exactly what would be removed and changes nothing. Then, once the person agrees, call again with confirm true. Up to 50 at a time. Only your own pictures. Free.

asset_ids.description: The picture ids, from list_my_assets or show_media.

confirm.description: Leave it out first: the answer says exactly what would be removed. Set true only after the person agrees.

name: delete_my_asset
title: Delete Pictures
